title: Google Launches Ask YouTube: Users Over 13 in the US Can Now Use AI Chat Search
excerpt: Google has officially rolled out its conversational search tool "Ask YouTube" to all users in the United States who are 13 years old and above, covering mobile
content_html:
Google has officially rolled out its conversational search tool "Ask YouTube" to all users in the United States who are 13 years old and above, covering mobile devices, desktop browsers, and smart TVs. Previously, this feature was only available to YouTube Premium members. YouTube first launched a limited test of the feature on mobile devices in April this year, and then expanded it to desktops.

"Ask YouTube" adds a "Ask" button in the search bar, allowing users to enter a chat-like interface where they can ask complex questions in full, natural language. Unlike traditional keyword searches that only return a list of videos, this tool generates structured, conversational answers based on YouTube's video database and includes relevant video clips. Users can also ask follow-up questions based on the context without having to re-enter the original question.

For example, if a user asks, "Plan a three-day road trip from San Francisco to Santa Barbara," the system can generate a text itinerary and recommend related videos, and further answer questions about dining and photo spots along the way. Currently, "Ask YouTube" is only available in English in the United States. Google said it is working on expanding to international markets and adding more language support.

This expansion further advances YouTube's evolution from a video search platform to an AI-driven information discovery and research tool.

content_html_zh:
谷歌已正式向美国所有13岁及以上用户推出对话式搜索工具“Ask YouTube”，涵盖移动设备、桌面浏览器和智能电视。 此前，此功能仅适用于 YouTube Premium 会员。 YouTube于今年4月首次在移动设备上推出了该功能的有限测试，随后将其扩展到桌面设备。

“Ask YouTube”在搜索栏中添加了一个“Ask”按钮，允许用户进入一个类似聊天的界面，在那里他们可以用完整、自然的语言提出复杂的问题。 与仅返回视频列表的传统关键字搜索不同，该工具根据 YouTube 的视频数据库生成结构化的对话式答案，并包含相关视频剪辑。 用户还可以根据上下文提出后续问题，而无需重新输入原始问题。

例如，如果用户询问“计划从旧金山到圣巴巴拉的三天公路旅行”，系统可以生成文本行程并推荐相关视频，并进一步回答有关沿途餐饮和拍照点的问题。 目前，“Ask YouTube”在美国仅提供英语版本。 谷歌表示，它正在努力拓展国际市场并增加更多语言支持。

这一扩展进一步推动了 YouTube 从视频搜索平台向人工智能驱动的信息发现和研究工具的演变。
